headline: Meta's open-weight Muse Spark lands as AI-linked market jitters hit global funds, while Indian IT earnings lift Sensex and Hormuz and Black Sea attacks escalate.

stories.title: 43 journalists detained covering protests against CEC: CPJ
stories.summary: The Committee to Protect Journalists says police detained 43 journalists and assaulted several covering protests against the CEC. This happened even after the Supreme Court secured assurances from the Solicitor-General that the press would not be impeded.
stories.why_it_matters: Press freedom and the Election Commission's conduct are major national political issues.

stories.title: ECI bulk voter deletions used auto-generated Form-7s
stories.summary: Form-7s were auto-generated for lakhs of voters, with the ERO in place of the objector. Deletions were effected without a notice period.
stories.why_it_matters: It raises questions on electoral roll integrity, covered by Telangana's regional desk.

stories.title: New CURE law to overhaul Hyderabad's urban governance
stories.summary: A new CURE law seeks to overhaul urban governance in Hyderabad. Separately, the city's four police commissionerates have been redrawn nine months after their creation.
stories.why_it_matters: It directly affects governance and policing in Hyderabad.

stories.title: Poor monsoon cuts Telangana Kharif cultivation to lowest since 2022
stories.summary: Kharif cultivation extent has fallen to its lowest since 2022, and groundwater depletion adds to farmers' woes. Power utilities are also affected.
stories.why_it_matters: It hits the Telangana rural economy and power sector.

stories.title: Chhattisgarh anti-conversion law takes effect; Maharashtra law raises concerns
stories.summary: Churches in Chhattisgarh have put up 'enter at own risk' boards for non-Christians after the Freedom of Religion Act, 2026 took effect. Maharashtra's similar law has created unease among minorities and interfaith couples.
stories.why_it_matters: These are significant state-level policy and civil-liberty developments.

stories.title: Sharmila demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation
stories.summary: APCC president Sharmila alleges unilateral decisions in the Election Commission raise questions over transparency and accountability.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows the CEC row spreading into Andhra Pradesh politics.

stories.title: Heritage activists oppose open cast coal mine near Ramappa Temple
stories.summary: Activists fear an open cast coal mine near the Ramappa Temple in Telangana threatens the World Heritage Site.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a Telangana heritage versus mining conflict.

stories.title: Telangana revenue receipts lag budget estimates
stories.summary: Actual revenue averaged ₹1.6 lakh crore in 2022-25 against estimates of ₹2 lakh crore.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows fiscal stress in Telangana.

stories.title: Centre directs telcos to display caller names from November 1
stories.summary: DoT has directed operators to roll out calling name presentation (CNAP) from November 1.
stories.why_it_matters: It changes everyday phone use and spam or fraud handling.

stories.title: Ship attacks near Hormuz at record high
stories.summary: BBC Verify analysis shows 12 vessels were struck in a week near Hormuz as oil exports slow.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a direct risk to oil prices and India's import bill.

stories.title: Drone attack leaves tanker ablaze off Romania; seven crew missing
stories.summary: Suspected Russian drones attacked a chemical tanker within Romanian waters, the first such attack in NATO territorial waters. Seven crew are missing.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a major escalation touching a NATO member.

stories.title: Zelensky says pause on energy strikes is over
stories.summary: Zelensky says the pause on striking energy sites has ended after fresh Russian attacks. Russia accuses Ukraine of hitting an oil refinery.
stories.why_it_matters: Energy-infrastructure war affects oil and gas markets.

stories.title: School roof collapse kills at least 33 children in Peshawar
stories.summary: A roof crashed through three classrooms in Pakistan, burying children. Al Jazeera reports at least 34 children killed.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a major tragedy in a neighbouring country.

stories.title: Three children and a teacher killed in Oregon school shooting
stories.summary: A 16-year-old opened fire at a primary school in Bend, Oregon. A bystander shot the suspect dead.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a major US news event.

stories.title: Houthi missiles hit Yemeni presidential palace
stories.summary: Ballistic missiles hit al-Maashiq Palace, killing five. The prime minister and other ministers were unhurt.
stories.why_it_matters: It signals escalation in Yemen near key shipping routes.

stories.title: Indonesia battles worst forest fires in over a decade
stories.summary: Four people have died and Jakarta says it will accept foreign help.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a significant climate and disaster story.

stories.title: Sensex recovers 700 points from low as IT extends rally
stories.summary: Sensex and Nifty (near 23,150) recovered after a dip. IT rose for a fourth session led by Tech Mahindra and Infosys.
stories.why_it_matters: It is the day's key index move and the reason behind it.

stories.title: Global hedge funds hit as AI trade unwinds
stories.summary: Asia-focused stock pickers lost 6.8% in early October, and global long-short funds fell 2.9% through October 15. Investors are unwinding AI trades amid inflation worries and rate-hike expectations.
stories.why_it_matters: It signals global risk-off linked to AI valuations.

stories.title: KOSPI and Nikkei rebound but weekly losses are steep
stories.summary: KOSPI rose 2.36% but is headed for its biggest weekly loss since October 2008. Nikkei rebounded 1.75% after six losing sessions.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows how broad the Asian selloff is.

stories.title: Rupee at 94.79 per dollar after RBI intervention
stories.summary: The rupee rose 20 paise to 94.79. High crude and FII selling limited gains.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows pressure on the currency and inflation.

stories.title: Bandhan AMC on RBI rate hikes and debt strategy
stories.summary: Suyash Choudhary explains how rising rates affect savers and advises keeping debt duration short.
stories.why_it_matters: It is relevant to RBI policy and debt allocation.

stories.title: IT results: Tech Mahindra jumps on bonus, Wipro and Persistent mixed
stories.summary: Tech Mahindra rose 7% on 32.7% profit growth, a ₹15 dividend and a 1:1 bonus. Wipro profit fell 1.9% YoY to ₹3,200 crore, while Persistent fell 5% on margin pressure.
stories.why_it_matters: It gives a read on IT-services demand and hiring.

stories.title: Sebi revises closing auction session framework
stories.summary: After 20,000+ comments, Sebi set a 10-minute closing auction and restored VWAP for F&O expiry settlement. Most changes take effect December 7, 2026.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a market-structure rule change.

stories.title: Major AMCs halt bulk gold ETF subscriptions
stories.summary: HDFC, Kotak Mahindra and UTI halted bulk subscriptions ahead of the festive season. Existing SIPs are covered in the report.
stories.why_it_matters: It affects gold ETF investors.

stories.title: Centre approves 30-day bonus for employees
stories.summary: The ad-hoc bonus for 2025-26 can reach ₹6,908 under the ₹7,000 ceiling.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a personal-finance and policy item.

stories.title: Sebi PRIM route cuts PMS minimum to ₹25 lakh
stories.summary: The minimum drops from ₹50 lakh, but renewals count as fresh investments.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a rule change for investment products.

stories.title: Jio Platforms IPO set for Oct 21-23, 2026
stories.summary: The issue is expected to raise ₹28,755-30,213 crore, with subscription October 21-23. Reliance shares fell as much as 2.5%.
stories.why_it_matters: It would be among India's largest IPOs.

stories.title: Tonbo Imaging IPO subscribed 4x on day 1
stories.summary: The ₹852 crore IPO was oversubscribed 4x, with NIIs leading demand.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows ongoing IPO subscription status.

stories.title: Sebi proposes 10 changes to SME IPO rules
stories.summary: Sebi has proposed sweeping changes to rules governing SME IPOs.
stories.why_it_matters: It affects the IPO regulatory framework.

stories.title: Meta releases open-weight Muse Spark Open
stories.summary: Meta launched Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter open-weight model for coding and agentic tasks, calling it the most capable US open-weight model. It can run locally on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios via MLX.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a major open model for AI engineering work.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO valuation talk drops to ~$1.5T; NYC pension fund urges delay
stories.summary: Investors discussed about $1.5 trillion versus the roughly $2 trillion earlier expected for the November sale. NYC's pension comptroller asked Anthropic to delay its IPO over risks.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a key AI-industry capital event.

stories.title: CoreWeave slump spotlights debt behind AI boom
stories.summary: CoreWeave carries about $50 billion in debt and has become the poster child for credit-fuelled data center concerns.
stories.why_it_matters: It explains the AI market jitters.

stories.title: Anthropic gives METR employee-level access
stories.summary: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic's risks, incidents and practices, and Anthropic gave up the right to block them.
stories.why_it_matters: It is an AI safety oversight precedent.

stories.title: FTC reportedly probes Anthropic and OpenAI
stories.summary: The FTC may fine AI firms on par with companies that delay data breach reports.
stories.why_it_matters: It signals regulatory risk for AI vendors.

stories.title: ChatGPT Chrome extension can use open tabs
stories.summary: ChatGPT can view your open browser tabs when you tag Chrome in the app.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows the direction of browser agents.

stories.title: Instagram's AI-native UI migration cuts token costs 33%
stories.summary: Instagram Direct moved from Android Views to Jetpack Compose, cutting UI code volume by 50% and token costs per agent session by 33%.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a concrete example of codebases built for AI agents.

stories.title: Ramp and Stripe build internal vibe-coding platforms
stories.summary: Both built platforms letting non-engineers create internal tools, and both are taking off.
stories.why_it_matters: It shows a trend in engineering work.

stories.title: Spring Security 7: server-side DPoP and token exchange
stories.summary: The guide covers enabling DPoP and RFC 8693 token exchange, and warns that 7.1 apps can silently stop enforcing DPoP until .dPoP() is called.
stories.why_it_matters: It is relevant for Java backend security.

stories.title: Grafana Tempo 3.1 adds Kafka client TLS/SASL
stories.summary: Tempo 3.1 adds query-based trace redaction and additional SASL mechanisms for its Kafka client.
stories.why_it_matters: It is relevant to Kafka and observability work.

stories.title: Targeted ads delivered 0-click exploits for mercenary spyware
stories.summary: This is likely the first confirmation of mercenary spyware delivered via targeted ads.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a notable security development.

stories.title: Flipkart FY26 revenue ₹1.45 lakh crore; loss narrows to ₹8,468 crore
stories.summary: Revenue rose 18.2%. Separately, Udaan's revenue rose 13% to ₹5,134 crore with loss narrowing to ₹852 crore.
stories.why_it_matters: It gives a health check on Indian tech employers.

stories.title: Former Flipkart staff seek Esop buyout from Walmart
stories.summary: Ex-employees are asking Walmart to cash out their vested stock options.
stories.why_it_matters: It is relevant to startup equity.

stories.title: Shopify to bring Shop Pay to India
stories.summary: Shopify is preparing to launch its accelerated checkout product in India by Q1.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a fintech and payments development.

stories.title: India's Mandhana era begins in Raipur vs Zimbabwe
stories.summary: Smriti Mandhana starts as India captain in a series against Zimbabwe, who are playing their first bilateral series against India.
stories.why_it_matters: It is a leadership change for India.

stories.title: South Africa's middle order in a muddle after 214-run loss
stories.summary: The coach said he could look outside the squad but cautioned against overreacting. Stubbs is dropped for the Gqeberha Test.
stories.why_it_matters: It covers an ongoing major Test series.
